1. 4H-SiC AR Waveguide Hazards & Legacy Limits
A. J-FIL Nanoimprint RLT Swelling (24.5nm) & Bubbles
• High-index ZrO2/TiO2 resist viscosity drift stalls drop spreading
• Residual Layer Thickness swells to 24.5 nm (>8.0 nm ceiling)
• Traps 45nm micro-bubbles & ruins subsequent RIE pattern transfer
✗ Destructive cross-section SEM cannot prevent in-situ UV flash cure
B. Inclined Ion-Beam Slanted-Grating Drift (+1.85°)
• Plasma sheath bowing shifts 42.0° blaze angle by +1.85°
• Mismatches RGB diffraction efficiency across 70° eye-box FoV
• Induces severe color mura & rainbow ghosting in AR combiners
✗ Requires 14ms +18% drop-map + +1.2s He purge & -1.82° IBE tilt
C. 990K EPS Write Tax & 408M DRAM Vector Bloat
